## Privacy reminder

**Do not attach real PDFs or paste real transaction data.** If you want to help build the parser, share fabricated examples only.

---

## Bank and card / account

Which bank, and which specific card or account type? (e.g. DBS Altitude Visa, Maybank Horizon Visa)

## Statement format

What kind of PDF is it?

- [ ] Digital (embedded text — opens in a PDF reader and you can select/copy text)
- [ ] Scanned image (no selectable text — like HSBC statements)
- [ ] Unknown

## Are you willing to help build the parser?

- [ ] Yes — I can share fabricated sample text from the browser console
- [ ] No — just requesting

## Additional context

Anything unusual about the format? Multi-card consolidated PDF? Multi-column layout? Non-standard date format?
